directive: 通知の発生状況と話者を踏まえ、必要な情報を簡潔に伝える。変数を保つ。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Well, at the very least, try to study those documents or find someone who can interpret them! I'm a smart guy but bio-chemistry isn't my field, so I don't understand anything in there. You need to find a scientist familiar with virology or biochemistry. We had a whole lot of science experts from a variety of fields in our expedition, but most of them ended up getting killed by the army, so I can't help you there. I'm sorry, man!
entries.JA_current: Well, at the very least, try to study those documents or find someone who can interpret them! I'm a smart guy but bio-chemistry isn't my field, so I don't understand anything in there. You need to find a scientist familiar with virology or biochemistry. We had a whole lot of science experts from a variety of fields in our expedition, but most of them ended up getting killed by the army, so I can't help you there. I'm sorry, man!
entries.JA_new: とにかく、書類を調べるか、内容を読み解ける人を探してください！　私は頭はいいほうですが、生化学は専門外で何も分かりません。ウイルス学か生化学に詳しい科学者が必要です。遠征にはさまざまな分野の専門家が大勢参加していましたが、ほとんどがミリタリーに殺されてしまった。力になれなくてすみません！

entries.EN: There's a mobile science lab at Yantar, you think I should try with the brainiacs over there?
entries.JA_current: There's a mobile science lab at Yantar, you think I should try with the brainiacs over there?
entries.JA_new: ヤンターに移動式研究所がある。あそこの科学者たちに相談してみるべきか？

entries.EN: Yeah, go for it! I think the Zone is a little short on scientists nowadays, so no harm in going to ask those who remain.
entries.JA_current: Yeah, go for it! I think the Zone is a little short on scientists nowadays, so no harm in going to ask those who remain.
entries.JA_new: そうだ、行ってみろ！　今のゾーンには科学者が少ない。残っている人たちに聞いても損はないさ。

entries.EN: I see.
entries.JA_current: I see.
entries.JA_new: 分かりました。

entries.EN: I'm infected.
entries.JA_current: I'm infected.
entries.JA_new: 感染した。

entries.EN: I see. Right, down to business at hand - check out these documents, please.
entries.JA_current: I see. Right, down to business at hand - check out these documents, please.
entries.JA_new: 分かりました。では本題に入ろう。この書類を見てくれないか。

entries.EN: Well now... This is interesting... Where did you get these from?!
entries.JA_current: Well now... This is interesting... Where did you get these from?!
entries.JA_new: これは興味深い……どこで手に入れたんだ？！

entries.EN: It doesn't matter now... Did you find anything useful?
entries.JA_current: It doesn't matter now... Did you find anything useful?
entries.JA_new: 今はどうでもいい……何か役に立つ情報は見つかったか？

entries.EN: Well, it would take time for me to process such quantities of statistical data in detail... It appears this data is all about something known as "ZNOY-13", a biological agent of some sort.. Ah, there, it mentions a field lab at X-18, that's beneath the Dark Valley..
entries.JA_current: Well, it would take time for me to process such quantities of statistical data in detail... It appears this data is all about something known as "ZNOY-13", a biological agent of some sort.. Ah, there, it mentions a field lab at X-18, that's beneath the Dark Valley..
entries.JA_new: これほどの統計データを詳しく分析するには時間がかかるが……「ZNOY-13」という生物剤についての資料のようだ……ああ、ここにX-18の野外研究所があると書いてある。ダークバレーの地下だ……

entries.EN: I know that already!
entries.JA_current: I know that already!
entries.JA_new: それはもう知っています！

entries.EN: Well, there's apparently another field lab at X-16, right under our noses!
entries.JA_current: Well, there's apparently another field lab at X-16, right under our noses!
entries.JA_new: さらに、すぐ近くのX-16にも野外研究所があるようだ！

entries.EN: Go on...
entries.JA_current: Go on...
entries.JA_new: 続けてください……

entries.EN: At the moment I'm unable to identify what code-name "ZNOY-13" really is, not enough info to go on from this paper without further context. Perhaps the test site at X-16 will have more information?
entries.JA_current: At the moment I'm unable to identify what code-name "ZNOY-13" really is, not enough info to go on from this paper without further context. Perhaps the test site at X-16 will have more information?
entries.JA_new: 今のところ、この書類だけでは「ZNOY-13」というコードネームの正体を特定できない。情報が足りず、前後関係も分からないからだ。X-16の実験施設に行けば、もっと情報が見つかるかもしれない。

entries.EN: Thank you, Professor. I'll be back soon.
entries.JA_current: Thank you, Professor. I'll be back soon.
entries.JA_new: ありがとうございます、教授。また戻ってきます。

entries.EN: Done at last, Professor. I'm back!
entries.JA_current: Done at last, Professor. I'm back!
entries.JA_new: やっと終わりました、教授。戻りました！

entries.EN: I'm very pleased to see you. Have you discovered anything?
entries.JA_current: I'm very pleased to see you. Have you discovered anything?
entries.JA_new: 会えてうれしいよ。何か分かったかね？

entries.EN: I have. Here you are...
entries.JA_current: I have. Here you are...
entries.JA_new: はい。こちらです……

entries.EN: Oh my God! Take a look at these photos! "ZNOY-13" seems to be an experimental virus of some sort, a bio-weapon, perhaps!
entries.JA_current: Oh my God! Take a look at these photos! "ZNOY-13" seems to be an experimental virus of some sort, a bio-weapon, perhaps!
entries.JA_new: なんてことだ！　この写真を見てくれ！　「ZNOY-13」は実験用ウイルス、あるいは生物兵器のようだ！

entries.EN: Damn it! I take it human testing has already been carried out?
entries.JA_current: Damn it! I take it human testing has already been carried out?
entries.JA_new: くそっ！　もう人体実験まで行われたのか？

entries.EN: Hmm, let me check that... My god... Yes, it appears so... It is mentioned in the methodology section that a number of convicts underwent forced infection.. How unethical, if they'd heard about this at the institute, BAH! However, I need to ask, why did you mention human testing in the first place? Is there anything I should know?
entries.JA_current: Hmm, let me check that... My god... Yes, it appears so... It is mentioned in the methodology section that a number of convicts underwent forced infection.. How unethical, if they'd heard about this at the institute, BAH! However, I need to ask, why did you mention human testing in the first place? Is there anything I should know?
entries.JA_new: うーむ、確認してみよう……なんということだ……本当らしい。手順書によると、複数の囚人に強制的に感染させたようだ……なんと非倫理的な！　研究所で知られたら……まったく！　ところで、なぜ最初に人体実験のことを聞いたんだ？　何か隠しているのかね？

entries.EN: Because I have been exposed to this damn thing myself.
entries.JA_current: Because I have been exposed to this damn thing myself.
entries.JA_new: 僕自身が、そいつに感染したからです。

entries.EN: Good Lord... How?? When?!
entries.JA_current: Good Lord... How?? When?!
entries.JA_new: 何だって……どうしてだ？！　いつ？！

entries.EN: Well... I found this container with a broken seal. I peeked inside and found some documents, I had no idea I was exposed to anything until a scientist took a blood sample and confirmed presence of an unidentified virus. Any word in these papers about a cure or vaccine or anything??
entries.JA_current: Well... I found this container with a broken seal. I peeked inside and found some documents, I had no idea I was exposed to anything until a scientist took a blood sample and confirmed presence of an unidentified virus. Any word in these papers about a cure or vaccine or anything??
entries.JA_new: 封印の壊れたケースを見つけたんです。中を覗いたら書類が入っていた。科学者に血液を採られて、正体不明のウイルスがいると分かるまで、何かに感染したとは思いもしませんでした。治療薬やワクチンについて、書類に何か書いてありませんか？

entries.EN: There are some mentions of something along those lines, but I would prefer to check the contents of the container first.
entries.JA_current: There are some mentions of something along those lines, but I would prefer to check the contents of the container first.
entries.JA_new: それらしい記述はあるが、先にケースの中身を確認したい。

entries.EN: It's empty, I checked.
entries.JA_current: It's empty, I checked.
entries.JA_new: 空でした。確認しました。

entries.EN: Not that one, the second one. From the X-16 field lab?
entries.JA_current: Not that one, the second one. From the X-16 field lab?
entries.JA_new: そのケースではない。2つ目のケースだ。X-16の野外研究所にあったものは？

entries.EN: I didn't find any container down there.. Only this document folder.
entries.JA_current: I didn't find any container down there.. Only this document folder.
entries.JA_new: 地下ではケースを見つけませんでした……あったのは、この書類の束だけです。

entries.EN: There must be one more container!
entries.JA_current: There must be one more container!
entries.JA_new: ケースがもう一つあるはずだ！

entries.EN: Listen.. Have any stalkers been around recently, asking weird questions?
entries.JA_current: Listen.. Have any stalkers been around recently, asking weird questions?
entries.JA_new: ところで……最近、妙な質問をするストーカーが来なかったか？

entries.EN: Yes, there was one stalker. He was also asking unusual questions, much like yourself.
entries.JA_current: Yes, there was one stalker. He was also asking unusual questions, much like yourself.
entries.JA_new: ええ、一人いました。あなたと同じように、変わった質問をしていました。

entries.EN: Do you have any idea where he went?
entries.JA_current: Do you have any idea where he went?
entries.JA_new: どこへ行ったか分かるか？

entries.EN: Unfortunately, none... But it seemed to me like he was planning on going to the laboratory.
entries.JA_current: Unfortunately, none... But it seemed to me like he was planning on going to the laboratory.
entries.JA_new: 残念ながら分かりません……でも、研究所へ行くつもりのようでした。

entries.EN: Well, I've been to the lab, but I met no stalkers down there.
entries.JA_current: Well, I've been to the lab, but I met no stalkers down there.
entries.JA_new: 地下へ行ったが、ストーカーには誰も会わなかった。

entries.EN: Perhaps he is still planning his entry.
entries.JA_current: Perhaps he is still planning his entry.
entries.JA_new: まだ侵入する方法を探しているのかもしれない。

entries.EN: Huh, very well, I'll keep an eye out.
entries.JA_current: Huh, very well, I'll keep an eye out.
entries.JA_new: そうか。気に留めておこう。

entries.EN: Professor! I have finally found the second case!
entries.JA_current: Professor! I have finally found the second case!
entries.JA_new: 教授！　2つ目のケースを見つけました！

entries.EN: That is wonderful news indeed! Let me take a look, please... Right, clamps detached... Curious... Well, I'm sorry young man, it seems that I won't be able to help you... You require people more competent in this matter than I could ever hope to be. Perhaps I could...
entries.JA_current: That is wonderful news indeed! Let me take a look, please... Right, clamps detached... Curious... Well, I'm sorry young man, it seems that I won't be able to help you... You require people more competent in this matter than I could ever hope to be. Perhaps I could...
entries.JA_new: それは本当に朗報だ！　見せてくれ……なるほど、留め具が外れている……妙だな……いや、すまない。君の力にはなれそうにない。私よりも、この問題に詳しい人が必要だ。そうだ、もしかすると……

entries.EN: Wait, that's just it! Just had a name flash in my head: Zamyslov!
entries.JA_current: Wait, that's just it! Just had a name flash in my head: Zamyslov!
entries.JA_new: 待ってください！　思い出しました。ザムィスロフです！

entries.EN: What Zamyslov? Who's that??
entries.JA_current: What Zamyslov? Who's that??
entries.JA_new: ザムィスロフ？　誰だね？

entries.EN: The scientist I met in Agroprom Underground. I have to get moving, sorry!
entries.JA_current: The scientist I met in Agroprom Underground. I have to get moving, sorry!
entries.JA_new: アフロプロム地下で会った科学者です。急いで行かないと。すみません！

entries.EN: Hi, my friend!
entries.JA_current: Hi, my friend!
entries.JA_new: よう、相棒！

entries.EN: Hi yourself! The military send their regards.
entries.JA_current: Hi yourself! The military send their regards.
entries.JA_new: そっちもな！　ミリタリーからよろしくと言われてるぜ。

entries.EN: I don't get what you mean?!
entries.JA_current: I don't get what you mean?!
entries.JA_new: どういう意味だ？！

entries.EN: Sure you don't... Don't worry though, I'm not here on the Army's behalf. Are you "Outrage"?
entries.JA_current: Sure you don't... Don't worry though, I'm not here on the Army's behalf. Are you "Outrage"?
entries.JA_new: 分からないよな……心配するな、軍の使いで来たわけじゃない。あんたが「アウトレイジ」か？

entries.EN: No... He's away. I see you know a lot... Too much, in fact. Aren't you worried about your health? People have accidents in the Zone all the time, maybe you'll fall into an anomaly some time, if you're not careful!
entries.JA_current: No... He's away. I see you know a lot... Too much, in fact. Aren't you worried about your health? People have accidents in the Zone all the time, maybe you'll fall into an anomaly some time, if you're not careful!
entries.JA_new: 違う……あいつは出かけてる。よく知ってるな……知りすぎなくらいだ。命が惜しくないのか？　ゾーンじゃ事故なんて日常茶飯事だ。気をつけないと、いつかアノマリーに落ちるぞ！

entries.EN: You bet! I'm constantly thinking about finding myself a quiet place to kick the bucket. So, where do I find that asshole friend of yours?
entries.JA_current: You bet! I'm constantly thinking about finding myself a quiet place to kick the bucket. So, where do I find that asshole friend of yours?
entries.JA_new: そうだな！　静かな場所で死ぬことばかり考えてるよ。ところで、あんたのクソ野郎の友達はどこだ？

entries.EN: Asshole?! You've got some balls, you know that?? But I suppose it'll be better to let "Outrage" deal with you, I ain't gonna waste my ammo on some fool. He's at the Army Warehouses right now. I'll let him know you're coming, he'll be eager for a meet and greet, heh!
entries.JA_current: Asshole?! You've got some balls, you know that?? But I suppose it'll be better to let "Outrage" deal with you, I ain't gonna waste my ammo on some fool. He's at the Army Warehouses right now. I'll let him know you're coming, he'll be eager for a meet and greet, heh!
entries.JA_new: クソ野郎だと？！　いい度胸だな、お前！　だが、あいつに任せたほうがよさそうだ。馬鹿のために弾を無駄にしたくない。今は軍事倉庫にいる。来ることは伝えておくよ。きっと会うのを楽しみにするだろうな、はは！

entries.EN: I'll be looking forward to it!
entries.JA_current: I'll be looking forward to it!
entries.JA_new: 楽しみにしてるよ！

entries.EN: Greetings!
entries.JA_current: Greetings!
entries.JA_new: ようこそ！

entries.EN: Hello. Barkeep has sent me.
entries.JA_current: Hello. Barkeep has sent me.
entries.JA_new: こんにちは。バーキープに頼まれて来た。

entries.EN: So what?
entries.JA_current: So what?
entries.JA_new: それで？

entries.EN: I want to find out everything you know about Freedom and the military working together.
entries.JA_current: I want to find out everything you know about Freedom and the military working together.
entries.JA_new: フリーダムとミリタリーが協力している件で、知っていることを全部聞きたい。

entries.EN: What the hell are you talking about?! The Freedomers are anarchists and they love the Zone, they'd never work with the army!
entries.JA_current: What the hell are you talking about?! The Freedomers are anarchists and they love the Zone, they'd never work with the army!
entries.JA_new: 何を言ってるんだ？！　フリーダムは無政府主義者で、ゾーンを愛してる。軍と手を組むわけがないだろ！

entries.EN: When did you last go out scouting?
entries.JA_current: When did you last go out scouting?
entries.JA_new: 最後に偵察へ出たのはいつだ？

entries.EN: If I tell you, I'll have to kill you.
entries.JA_current: If I tell you, I'll have to kill you.
entries.JA_new: 話したら、お前を殺さなきゃならなくなる。

entries.EN: Look, wiseguy, I'm not even a scout and I seem to know more than you! I'm not aware of the details yet, but Kostya "Outrage" could shed some light on the matter. Problem is, I don't know his current location. And now I have two reasons to go for him.
entries.JA_current: Look, wiseguy, I'm not even a scout and I seem to know more than you! I'm not aware of the details yet, but Kostya "Outrage" could shed some light on the matter. Problem is, I don't know his current location. And now I have two reasons to go for him.
entries.JA_new: なあ、知ったかぶりはやめろ。俺は偵察兵ですらないのに、お前より知ってるみたいだな！　詳しいことは知らないが、コスチャ「アウトレイジ」なら事情を話せるかもしれない。問題は、今どこにいるか分からないことだ。これであいつを捜す理由が二つになった。

entries.EN: I've heard about "Outrage", but I can't help you find him. You should obtain a Freedomer's PDA and dig around in the files, maybe you could find him in the contacts or check correspondence, anything that suggests current whereabouts. Hey, maybe you could even message him yourself and ask, couldn't hurt.
entries.JA_current: I've heard about "Outrage", but I can't help you find him. You should obtain a Freedomer's PDA and dig around in the files, maybe you could find him in the contacts or check correspondence, anything that suggests current whereabouts. Hey, maybe you could even message him yourself and ask, couldn't hurt.
entries.JA_new: 「アウトレイジ」の噂は聞いてるが、居場所までは分からない。フリーダムのPDAを手に入れて、中のファイルを調べてみろ。連絡先やメールに、居場所の手がかりがあるかもしれない。本人にメッセージを送って聞いてみてもいい。損はないだろ。

entries.EN: Good idea! How do I get one, should I just waste one of them on patrol?
entries.JA_current: Good idea! How do I get one, should I just waste one of them on patrol?
entries.JA_new: いい考えだ！　どうやって手に入れる？　見回り中の奴を殺して奪えばいいか？

entries.EN: That's right, do what you gotta do. You'll get no complains from me if you take out one of those Freedom chumps, they deserve it. Well, so long, I'm out to hunt.
entries.JA_current: That's right, do what you gotta do. You'll get no complains from me if you take out one of those Freedom chumps, they deserve it. Well, so long, I'm out to hunt.
entries.JA_new: そうだ。必要なことをやれ。フリーダムの連中を一人始末しても文句はない。あいつらには当然の報いだ。じゃあな、狩りに行ってくる。

entries.EN: I've found a Freedom PDA, but I'm unable to get any information out of it. Requires a login and a password...
entries.JA_current: I've found a Freedom PDA, but I'm unable to get any information out of it. Requires a login and a password...
entries.JA_new: フリーダムのPDAを手に入れたが、情報を取り出せない。ログインIDとパスワードが必要だ……

entries.EN: So, the only way for me to proceed is to find that ass-kisser?
entries.JA_current: So, the only way for me to proceed is to find that ass-kisser?
entries.JA_new: じゃあ、その腰巾着を見つけるしかないのか？

entries.EN: Yep, I guess. But I haven't heard about him. That's a lousy story... Tell me honestly, why are you so concerned about all this shit? Loner like you, are you trying to help Duty to score brownie points or what?
entries.JA_current: Yep, I guess. But I haven't heard about him. That's a lousy story... Tell me honestly, why are you so concerned about all this shit? Loner like you, are you trying to help Duty to score brownie points or what?
entries.JA_new: そうだろうな。だが、そいつの噂は聞いたことがない。厄介な話だ……正直に言ってくれ。どうしてそこまで知りたいんだ？　ただのローナーのお前が、デューティーに恩を売ろうとしてるのか？

entries.EN: I'm just killing two birds with one stone. "Outrage" has got something I just can't get on without.
entries.JA_current: I'm just killing two birds with one stone. "Outrage" has got something I just can't get on without.
entries.JA_new: 一石二鳥さ。「アウトレイジ」が持ってるものがないと、先へ進めない。

entries.EN: Aww, did he steal your heart?
entries.JA_current: Aww, did he steal your heart?
entries.JA_new: へえ、あいつに惚れたのか？

entries.EN: Hmm... Guess that isn't far from the truth...
entries.JA_current: Hmm... Guess that isn't far from the truth...
entries.JA_new: うーん……まあ、あながち間違いでもないな……

entries.EN: Be good, man!
entries.JA_current: Be good, man!
entries.JA_new: じゃあな、気をつけろよ！

entries.EN: You too, dude.
entries.JA_current: You too, dude.
entries.JA_new: あんたもな。

entries.EN: Please, help me, bro...
entries.JA_current: Please, help me, bro...
entries.JA_new: 頼む、助けてくれ……

entries.EN: Yeah, sure. But first of all, you'll have to tell me something. You're part of a squad operating with "Outrage", aren't you?
entries.JA_current: Yeah, sure. But first of all, you'll have to tell me something. You're part of a squad operating with "Outrage", aren't you?
entries.JA_new: いいぜ。ただし、先に聞かせてくれ。「アウトレイジ」と一緒に動いている分隊の一員だな？

entries.EN: Yes, I am. What of it??
entries.JA_current: Yes, I am. What of it??
entries.JA_new: そうだ。それがどうした？

entries.EN: ...And you spy for Duty, don't you?
entries.JA_current: ...And you spy for Duty, don't you?
entries.JA_new: ……それで、デューティーに情報を流してるのか？

entries.EN: Hell, no! Fuck... What are you talking about?!
entries.JA_current: Hell, no! Fuck... What are you talking about?!
entries.JA_new: 違う！　くそっ……何を言ってるんだ？！

entries.EN: "Outrage" has tried to put you down. What for, I wonder?
entries.JA_current: "Outrage" has tried to put you down. What for, I wonder?
entries.JA_new: 「アウトレイジ」はお前を殺そうとした。なぜだろうな？

entries.EN: That's none of your business...
entries.JA_current: That's none of your business...
entries.JA_new: お前には関係ない……

entries.EN: Stay calm and don't go reaching for your gun. I don't have a problem with taking you out like a dog. Where's "Outrage"?
entries.JA_current: Stay calm and don't go reaching for your gun. I don't have a problem with taking you out like a dog. Where's "Outrage"?
entries.JA_new: 落ち着け。銃に手を伸ばすなよ。犬みたいに撃ち殺すのにためらいはない。アウトレイジはどこだ？

entries.EN: You're too late... The Bar has already been attacked.
entries.JA_current: You're too late... The Bar has already been attacked.
entries.JA_new: 遅かったな……バーはもう襲撃された。

entries.EN: How come?! That's impossible! He received the order about the shooting execution merely a moment ago!
entries.JA_current: How come?! That's impossible! He received the order about the shooting execution merely a moment ago!
entries.JA_new: どうしてだ？！　そんなはずはない！　あいつが銃殺命令を受けたのは、ほんの少し前だぞ！

entries.EN: Wow! Uf-f-f-f... I'm almost off my rocker because of all this. Where will the execution take place?
entries.JA_current: Wow! Uf-f-f-f... I'm almost off my rocker because of all this. Where will the execution take place?
entries.JA_new: うわっ！　はあ……この一件で気が狂いそうだ。処刑はどこで行われる？

entries.EN: Here, at the Army Warehouses.
entries.JA_current: Here, at the Army Warehouses.
entries.JA_new: ここだ。軍事倉庫でな。

entries.EN: Give me details!
entries.JA_current: Give me details!
entries.JA_new: 詳しく話せ！
